title: Transaction
description: Financial transaction record representing a money movement (deposit, withdrawal, transfer, payment). Tracks transaction amount, type, status, currency, and timestamp for accounting and financial tracking.

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who initiated or is associated with this transaction

amount.description: Transaction amount (positive for credits, negative for debits)

currency.description: ISO currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

type.description: Transaction type (e.g., deposit, withdrawal, transfer, payment, refund, fee)

status.description: Transaction status (e.g., pending, completed, failed, cancelled, refunded)

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the transaction occurred or was initiated
